current.title: Wake County Freshman Falsely Accused of AI Cheating Sparks Petition for K-12 Detection Policies
current.summary: A North Carolina high school freshman was wrongly flagged by three AI detection tools for an English assignment she wrote herself, prompting a student-led petition demanding that districts establish transparent AI detection guidelines and formal appeals processes before using such tools against students.

current.title: SUNY Makes AI Literacy a General Education Requirement Across All 64 Campuses Starting Fall 2026
current.summary: The State University of New York adopted a systemwide AI policy requiring all incoming undergraduates to complete AI literacy coursework starting Fall 2026, setting a major precedent for embedding foundational AI education into higher education curricula at scale.

current.title: FutureEd Tracker: 53 State Bills in 25 States Shape Classroom AI as PISA Readies First AI Literacy Assessment for 2029
current.summary: A new FutureEd legislative tracker reveals 53 active state bills across 25 states governing how AI is taught and used in K-12 schools, with urgency building around the news that PISA will for the first time test AI literacy among 15-year-olds worldwide in 2029.

archives.title: 31 States Introduce 134 AI Education Bills Targeting Student Data Privacy and Classroom Rules
archives.summary: A surge of 2026 state legislation is placing guardrails around AI in schools, with bills banning student data from being used to train AI models, requiring human oversight for high-stakes decisions, and adding AI instruction to graduation standards.

archives.title: Schools Worldwide Shift From AI Bans to Structured Deployment as UNESCO and EU Frameworks Take Hold
archives.summary: A 2026 review finds schools globally have moved past the ban-or-allow debate, now deploying AI as a productivity layer for teachers and administrators guided by UNESCO's generative AI guidance and the EU AI Act's phased rollout.

archives.title: Georgia and Mississippi Lead Push to Require AI Literacy Credits for High School Graduation
archives.summary: Multiple states are mandating AI instruction as part of computer science graduation requirements, signaling a national push to build foundational AI literacy among K-12 students before they enter the workforce.
